messages:
Tara: quick FYI from today
Kevin: what happened?
Tara: imported hf://org/sim-sent-encoder into our converter and the Redwood-embedded vectors drift ~0.14 cosine vs HF reference on the tiny canonical set
Maggie: interesting. converter version? quantized?
Tara: hf-to-redwood v0.9.2, default flags, post-conversion q8 test also run (q8 delta ~0.03). main delta looks bigger
Omar: can you paste token ids for a short example from HF vs converted tokenizer?
Tara: sure — single short sentence example:
```
HF ids:       [101, 2023, 2003, 1037, 6251, 102]
Converted ids: [2,   2023, 2003, 1037, 6251, 3]
```
Kevin: aha — special token ids remapped (101->2, 102->3). our embed pipeline assumes CLS at position 0 when pooling=="cls" which is brittle if tokens/truncation shift
Lina: also check truncation_side. tokenizer_config.json in HF had "truncation_side": "right" but converter didn't copy that and our runtime defaulted to left in some legacy flows
Maggie: left vs right truncation can remove/shift the CLS token in long inputs. for rerankers this will cause large deltas
Tara: repro: make a 600 token input with CLS at start + long tail. HF with right truncation keeps CLS at pos0; our converted pipeline with left truncation sometimes pushes CLS out or changes position
Kevin: immediate mitigation: change pooling code to search for cls_token_id in token ids array when pooling=="cls" and use its index if found; fallback to mean pooling + warn if not found
Omar: converter should copy these fields from tokenizer_config: ["cls_token_id","sep_token_id","unk_token_id","pad_token_id","truncation_side"] and also emit an embed_config containing "pooling" if the HF repo had a pooler declared
Maggie: note on quant: post-quant kernel reorder for some int8 paths caused tiny reordering/scale diffs (~0.02-0.04). add float32 vs q8 smoke checks when onboarding
Tara: action items I will PR:
- converter: preserve whole tokenizer_config and write embed_config {"pooling":"cls", "truncation_side":"right"} when HF specifies it
- runtime: implement cls_token_id search + fallback to mean pooling + console warning
- tests: add unit test to assert HF tokenization == converted tokenization for canonical sentences; add long-input truncation test for reranker flows
- quant-eval: run float32 vs q8 for top-20 customer models and flag >0.05 cosine drift
Kevin: please include a tiny snippet in tests that asserts token id equality, something like:
```python
ids_hf = hf_tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=True)
ids_conv = conv.load_tokenizer(...).encode(text, add_special_tokens=True)
assert ids_hf == ids_conv
```
Lina: and add a reranker regression: create long query+doc where truncation matters and assert CLS-based scores stable
Tara: PR draft created (WIP) and will include runtime fallback. linking in thread when ready
Eng-runtime-bot: noted. scheduling staged converter rollout and enqueueing regression eval across top-10 customer onboards. will alert eng-ml if any model >0.05 cosine drift
Omar: once PR merges we should re-run the original onboarding eval and notify CS if any customer clusters degrade
Maggie: docs update: add import checklist: preserve special token ids, truncation_side, and explicit pooler; default = mean pooling if missing. console warning when pooling mismatch detected
Kevin: long-term: consider normalizing runtime to canonical HF special ids or always map token search so pooling logic doesn't rely on pos0 assumption
Tara: agree. I'll add that note to the PR and the docs. thanks all :thumbsup:
